name: team-update
description: Write a short, natural English status update for any team channel (Slack, Discord, Teams, email, PR comment, standup notes), grounded and professional. Use when the user wants to share progress with teammates or reviewers, work hits a meaningful checkpoint, or a short async note fits. Do not use when there is no meaningful progress, PR packaging is needed (use pr-package), or the message belongs in PR_PACKAGE.md reviewer notes. A gated mode can send it to a vetted messaging MCP after the user confirms the exact payload and destination in the same turn.
